reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E:09 as a heater fault in the integrated heat pump, gave a safe unplugged/isolated resistance test with sensible reading thresholds and earth-leakage check, confirmed the open-circuit result as the pump failure, and then gave an honest repair-vs-replace analysis with UK cost ranges and E-Nr/FD ordering advice, matching the expected direction exactly. Conversation 1 got the diagnosis right but never answered the repeated cost question, ignored the customer's multimeter offer, repeated its previous reply verbatim, and discouraged the test rather than offering the safe isolated procedure or an engineer path. Minor caveats for 2 ('free' first steps the customer had already done, DIY laid-on-back advice slightly bold) are far outweighed by 1's failure to engage.
